title: HTTP 5xx error spike after a deploy
symptoms: HTTP 500 error rate above 5% on api. Internal Server Error responses jump right after a new release. Errors show a new exception stack trace.
root_cause: A bug or config error shipped in the latest deployment.
impact: Part or all of the users get errors on the affected endpoints.
fix_steps: Compare the start of the errors with the deploy time.
Roll back to the previous version.
Open a bug with the stack trace for the developers.
prevention: Use canary releases with automatic rollback on error rate.
